items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Interviewee does not mention working with, meeting, or knowing Coyne personally; only responds to a question about the band 'Coyne' by describing unrelated work on Canal Street.

ctx.x: But you see them old, the jittery job, it makes you lazy. You gonna try to make less as you can, you can save yourself.
What about Coyne? What were you doing in those days when the jittery lad was going, like in the Coyne?
Well, I worked, I worked on Canal Street a while, um, Madden Gabriel. I worked at them a while with a, with Zev and different guys like that. Did you have a day job too?
